plan_point: 77.44.7.D / D-02 malformed persisted authored CTA multi-field recovery

root_cause: Canvas and Inspector attempted native DOM string coercion on malformed persisted CTA text values, preventing repair UI initialization.
The repair-mode command allow-list omitted the Editor text surface command element.content.set; consequently the actual text textarea could not repair a malformed saved CTA.
fix: The Canvas/Inspector renderers now display only strings and finite numbers for legacy authored text; malformed objects render blank rather than throwing.

Recovery is transient and only created for loaded malformed drafts. While active, authored repairs must target a node that itself fails authored-content validation. The UI text command is permitted only for malformed heading/text/button/link nodes with string input. Other commands, valid sibling edits and non-text targets remain blocked.
After the last invalid authored field is repaired, full strict document validation resumes. Save remains draft-only; Publish remains a separate strict gate.
scenario: Open malformed persisted CTA with both href and text represented by non-string objects.
Repair href using the normal content property control, then repair text through the actual plain-text editor.
Save remains publish=false and preserves previous public snapshot.
Separate Publish exposes the repaired CTA.
Negative unit cases reject generic mutation, valid sibling mutation and content repair on a non-text node.
